item.title: Server Gets Suspended For Nothing, Watches Restaurant Fall Apart Without Him
item.description: When you work with and around people, there's always a possibility that someone will create a problem out of thin air. Some might even call it an inevitability. For this waiter, it was a simple scheduling question that—thanks to management—became his latest headache. However, he found the perfect way to respond to their conflicting instructions and short tempers! Quick thinking is a lovely thing to witness.

item.title: “AITA For Distancing Myself From My Daughter After She Took Her Mother’s Side?”
item.description: One of the most dreadful things you can do if you’re in a monogamous marriage is cheating on your partner. It gets even worse if you have kids together. Some people can choose to stay together even after infidelity and work through the relationship, but for many couples, divorce is the only option. A man, who chose the second option when his wife cheated on him, was even more heartbroken when his daughter tried to persuade him to reconsider the divorce.

item.title: Doctors Share Unethical Things They’ve Seen, Here Are The 36 Most Interesting Answers
item.description: Most patients assume the system works as it should, and most of the time, it does. But these accounts highlight exceptions that linger in memory precisely because they violate that expectation. The stories sparked discussion about accountability, pressure, and how even trained professionals can cross lines.

item.description: Whether you like it or not, people love reading about others’ conflicts. Some might say it’s a waste of time, but the truth is that it’s not just a morbid fascination - it’s a learning experience!
